        - generic [ref=e114]:
          - paragraph [ref=e115]:
            - text: The
            - strong [ref=e116]:
              - code [ref=e117]: fetch()
            - text: method of the
            - link "Window" [ref=e118] [cursor=pointer]:
              - /url: /en-US/docs/Web/API/Window
              - code [ref=e119]: Window
            - text: interface starts the process of fetching a resource from the network, returning a promise that is fulfilled once the response is available.
          - paragraph [ref=e120]:
            - text: The promise resolves to the
            - link "Response" [ref=e121] [cursor=pointer]:
              - /url: /en-US/docs/Web/API/Response
              - code [ref=e122]: Response
            - text: object representing the response to your request.
          - paragraph [ref=e123]:
            - text: A
            - code [ref=e124]: fetch()
            - text: promise only rejects when the request fails, for example, because of a badly-formed request URL or a network error. A
            - code [ref=e125]: fetch()
            - text: promise
            - emphasis [ref=e126]: does not
            - text: reject if the server responds with HTTP status codes that indicate errors (
            - code [ref=e127]: "404"
            - text: ","
            - code [ref=e128]: "504"
            - text: ", etc.). Instead, a"
            - code [ref=e129]: then()
            - text: handler must check the
            - link "Response.ok" [ref=e130] [cursor=pointer]:
              - /url: /en-US/docs/Web/API/Response/ok
              - code [ref=e131]: Response.ok
            - text: and/or
            - link "Response.status" [ref=e132] [cursor=pointer]:
              - /url: /en-US/docs/Web/API/Response/status
              - code [ref=e133]: Response.status
            - text: properties.
          - paragraph [ref=e134]:
            - text: The
            - code [ref=e135]: fetch()
            - text: method is controlled by the
            - code [ref=e136]: connect-src
            - text: directive of
            - link "Content Security Policy" [ref=e137] [cursor=pointer]:
              - /url: /en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Reference/Headers/Content-Security-Policy
            - text: rather than the directive of the resources it's retrieving.
          - paragraph [ref=e139]:
            - strong [ref=e140]: "Note:"
            - text: The
            - code [ref=e141]: fetch()
            - text: method's parameters are identical to those of the
            - link "Request()" [ref=e142] [cursor=pointer]:
              - /url: /en-US/docs/Web/API/Request/Request
              - code [ref=e143]: Request()
            - text: constructor.
